"""Closed-loop insertion controller for ALOHA-2 #1 (vision + force servo)."""

    r = workcell.call("robot", *a)
    return r

    r = workcell.call("vision", "locate", "--json")
    t = r.text if isinstance(r.text, str) else ""
    try:

        pass
